money.opportunityDescription: Improving margin and revenue predictability is one of the fastest ways to increase what your business is worth.
money.constraintDescription: Unpredictable profit and cash flow make it harder to plan, finance, or eventually sell the business.
money.recommendation: Review your pricing and margins this month, and identify one way to make next month's revenue more predictable.

operations.opportunityDescription: Documented, repeatable processes turn what's in your head into something the business can rely on.
operations.constraintDescription: Without documented processes, quality and output depend on who happens to be doing the work.
operations.recommendation: Document your top two recurring processes as simple step-by-step guides this quarter.

growth.opportunityHeadline: Build a repeatable path to new customers
growth.opportunityDescription: A predictable way to generate demand makes future growth less dependent on luck or one-off effort.
growth.constraintDescription: Without a repeatable way to attract customers, growth is unpredictable and hard to plan around.
growth.recommendation: Identify the one marketing or sales activity that has worked best, and turn it into a repeatable process.

freedom.opportunityDescription: Every decision or relationship that moves off your desk gives you more freedom and makes the business more valuable.
freedom.constraintHeadline: The business depends heavily on you
freedom.constraintDescription: If the business can't run well without you, it limits your freedom and is worth less to a future buyer.
freedom.recommendation: Hand off one customer or vendor relationship you currently manage personally to a team member this month.

resilience.opportunityDescription: A business that can absorb setbacks is a business that can keep performing when life doesn't go according to plan.
resilience.constraintDescription: Without a financial or operational cushion, a single setback can put the business in real jeopardy.
resilience.recommendation: Set a target cash reserve and start setting aside a fixed amount each month until you reach it.
